conservative.requirements: You may use Fellowship or Agility for this action. Your Guile is opposed by the highest Willpower score amongst targets in range. Effect: You radically change your appearance while this card is recharging, becoming a beautiful maiden, an entrancing light, or some other beautiful and mysterious image appropriate to your size and environment. You cannot affect specific people, animals, or objects, and the change is only an illusion. You do not Fear or Terror while you wear the disguise, but when the visage drops your Fear or Terror rating (if any) increases by 1 for 1 round. You may recharge this action, completely as a manoeuvre, and change your form.

success.description: Special: You may use Fellowship or Agility for this action. Effect: The target no longer sees your form, but instead a pleasant and lovely illusion of your choice while this action is recharging. In order to target you with an attack action you do not wish to be affected by, the target must pass a Willpower check opposed by your Guile. On a failure, he suffers 1 stress and loses his action. You affect the target's mind as described above. As above, and the target is Perplexed while this action is recharging. You may affect a second target with WP no higher than the first. You gain the Exposed condition while this card is recharging.
